verdict.rationale: dlt is an open-source library you run yourself and configure to load into any destination you choose (docs-6, docs-21, docs-62), which implicitly lets you pick where data lands (e.g., your own regional DB/warehouse instance) since dlt itself doesn't store data. However, there is no explicit 'data residency' or region-selection feature, setting, or documentation addressing compliance/residency requirements — it's an emergent property of self-hosting rather than a designed capability. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency controls or documentation, compliance certifications, and any first-party statement about data residency guarantees for dltHub managed infra.
